findings.summary: gh_api() has no --max-time bound while gitea_api() got both 1800s and 60s ceilings.
findings.mechanism: The stated intent was to bound how long any single request can run, and gitea_api was updated with --max-time, but gh_api (used in the paginated enumeration loop) still has no timeout at all. A stalled/hung connection to api.github.com will block the script indefinitely despite the batch-resilience goal of this change.
